feat: add [shell] default_login config to control login shell behavior

Login shells (bash -lc) re-source startup scripts which can override
inherited PATH in curated environments. Add a configurable default via
[shell] default_login in config.toml so users can opt into non-login
shells while preserving backward compatibility.

Fixes #8922
